_note: Phase 4 figure-retrieval evaluation set (RETRIEVAL_UPGRADE_PLAN.md acceptance criterion: 'Evaluated with the Phase 3 harness -- not just demoed'). Every item's `expected` grounding was determined by extracting the real figure from the real ingested corpus and visually inspecting the actual image content before writing the query -- not generated then spot-checked. Deliberately smaller than Phase 3's 62-item text set (9 items): Phase 4 is explicitly scoped in the plan as additive/lower-priority ('only worth doing if Phases 1-3 are solid'), and this corpus only has ~105 real (non-decorative) embedded figures in course_id=4 to draw from.
